meta.title: Past Programs
meta.tagline: A decade of initiatives that shaped who we are today.
meta.seoDescription: Explore TIDE Foundation's history of educational initiatives — Prerak, BetterED, CompletEd, and EmpowerEd.

intro: Over the years, TIDE has run a series of deep, grounded educational programs. These initiatives have since evolved or concluded, but their learnings continue to shape everything we do.

programs.name: Prerak
programs.description: Bridging the academic learning gap through application-based holistic development — engaging students in self-learning, peer-learning, project-work and activity-based learning through kits, flashcards, games, and worksheets. Over time, this included a deep transformation program for whole-school improvement, alongside shorter interventions like activity-based bridge courses, holistic foundational learning, and ABL resource development.

programs.name: BetterED
programs.tagline: Life skills education for young people
programs.description: Providing life skills education to empower young people with skills for learning, employability, personal empowerment, and citizenship — to navigate everyday challenges at home, school, and community. Delivered through clubs, weekend classes, SDG workshops, and project-based sessions.

programs.name: CompletED
programs.description: Shaping socially responsible youth leaders through critical dialogue and action on social justice issues. Delivered through public talk series, thinking skills workshops, research programs, SDG drives, internships, and volunteering opportunities.

programs.name: EmpowerED
programs.description: Empowering educators through communities of practice, sharing effective practices, peer-learning, and action research in rural and alternative schools. Built communities of holistic educators from across the country, facilitated peer-to-peer learning, ran teacher professional development workshops, and set up peer- and self-observation routines.

cta.title: See what we're building today
cta.body: Our current work carries forward the best of these programs. Explore Education for Harmony and Pramaan to see how these learnings live on.
